prose: AMD's official press release confirms the definitive agreement to acquire World Labs for $8.2 billion. AMD frames the deal around model-infrastructure feedback: as AI expands into reasoning, robotics, simulation, and physical AI, World Labs' model expertise gives AMD insight into evolving workloads and shapes its hardware and software roadmaps, advancing its open-ecosystem infrastructure strategy. Lisa Su says building next-generation compute platforms 'requires a deep understanding of how models are evolving.' Dr. Fei-Fei Li's lab brings a world-class research team into AMD.
highlights: AMD confirms the definitive World Labs acquisition at $8.2B
Rationale: model expertise informs AMD's hardware, software, and systems roadmaps
Targets reasoning, robotics, simulation, and physical AI workloads
Lisa Su: next-gen compute platforms require deep understanding of model evolution
Advances AMD's open-ecosystem AI infrastructure strategy
quotes: deep understanding of how models are evolving
